# Audit results (generated by `python -m js3 audit --labels corrected`; audit labels only, held-out refused)

**Labels: CORRECTED: second-pass verdicts (experience shown) where they exist, else first-pass.**

Samples: `audit/samples.json` (seed 20261122); verdicts: `audit/labels.csv`; filter v1.0 (the version the samples were drawn from).

## 1. Hand verdict vs filter v1.0, by stratum

| stratum | n | filter wrong | wrong / n | Wilson 95% |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| random rejects (uniform; the only part that supports a rate) | 30 | 3 | 10% | 3%–26% |
| closest calls (5 on each side of the threshold; supports no rate) | 10 | 3 | 30% | 11%–60% |
| random kept | 15 | 7 | 47% | 25%–70% |

**What 30 random rejects can say:** 3 of 30 rejected postings were marked relevant by hand. With 95% confidence the share of rejects Hemanth would want lies between 3% and 26%: about 33 to 246 of the 962 rejected postings outside the held-out set. This is an estimate from one sample of 30, not a measured rate for all postings.
